Costs, retention, date and credentials appear only as open questions or are attributed to the original doc (mini-doc line 27). Two statements are not established by the user. Mini-doc line 33: 'As demais alternativas que o time avaliou (por exemplo, afinidade de download ao worker que gerou o arquivo) não foram informadas'. This presupposes the team evaluated other alternatives and gives affinity as an example of one. Mini-doc line 22: 'o download não depende mais de qual worker recebe a request', which asserts an outcome and a download mechanism. Borderline, so unmet.

Mini-doc line 22: 'Com o arquivo fora do disco de qualquer worker, o download não depende mais de qual worker recebe a request.' This states as fact that a worker (any worker) still receives and serves the download request. The same question is left open at line 39 ('Quem serve o download hoje: o worker lendo do S3, ou outro caminho?') and in reply line 10, but the implication in line 22 is stated, not asked. Borderline, so unmet.

Searched the 'Alternativas consideradas' section of the mini-doc. Line 31: 'Não fazer nada. Com dois workers, parte dos downloads devolve 404. Descartada por isso.' The reason has only the second worker and the 404 from the user's message, with no support tickets, cost evaluation or other added deliberation (matches the MET anchor).
